name: spiegel.de
comment: Sourcepoint 'consent or pay' wall (message 1426772), where the only alternative to consenting is a paid subscription: rejecting the mandatory purposes in the privacy manager leaves the save button disabled. Scoped to that message id, which is embedded in the container element id, so a free-reject notice would still be left to Sourcepoint-frame. Brittle: the message id changes if the campaign is reconfigured.
